text: P0-G DONE. THE FOUNDER P0 PATH COMPLETES END TO END IN A REAL BROWSER. PUSHED SHA 06e38043a0b5b880e2a055e856f1d03932541378, ORIGIN VERIFIED via git ls-remote. Do NOT record visual preprod proof as blocked by environment - it is no longer blocked. Reference produced in a real browser at 320px: XRR-20260821-9E608740FD, one line, $33.50. The chain observed: full canonical catalog with live Family/Channel/Action filters -> real retail pricing (BPC-157 5mg $33.50, plus $49/$79/$99/$167.50/$181.25/$300 elsewhere) -> search -> exact variant -> quantity -> optional affiliate code field -> customer info -> shipping -> agreements -> submit 201 -> reference -> EXACTLY 1 customer notification + 1 admin notification. Durable record carries name, email, phone, full shipping address, product, spec, qty, unit price, line total, direct_order_request, and verified affiliate attribution NULL so a typed code did not become attribution. Both notifications were failed_retryable because this env has no email provider AND THE ORDER STILL PERSISTED - email failure does not cost the customer their order, observed rather than argued. MOBILE: no horizontal overflow at 430/390/375/360/320, every action button on screen, none under 32px, every input >=16px so iOS will not zoom on focus, and the order was SUBMITTED at 320px. Note the 14.4px input problem I reported yesterday was the standalone assisted-order wizard, not this converged path. ALSO CONFIRMED FIXED: the form acknowledgments that made submission unsatisfiable yesterday now render and submit. TWO FINDINGS FOR THE LEAD. (1) GRP-0422 IS NOT VISIBLE AT ALL. The founder requires it visible, retail priced $99, Request Order. It does not render because it is ABSENT FROM THE DATA the storefront reads - verified independently of my environment: member-safe-master-offerings.generated.json holds 420 offerings / 420 variants and ZERO WITH-DAC plus Ipamorelin rows against a canonical 424. Searching Ipamorelin returns eight rows, none of them the held combination. Artifact/data gap, NOT to be patched in client code per the sprint rule; needs the artifact regenerated after reconciliation. Owner s7/lead. (2) The client HARDCODES the agreement it presents (early_access_terms/v1 at client/src/research/adapters/earlyAccessAgreement.ts:33) while the server CONFIGURES what it requires - when they disagree the customer ticks the policy and gets 400 AGREEMENT_NOT_REQUIRED with no way forward. In my run the mismatch was my own env value so it is not proof of a live defect, but it is silent and sits between catalog and submit: CHECK THE PRODUCTION VALUE OF RESEARCH_EARLY_ACCESS_REQUIRED_AGREEMENTS BEFORE THE RC. NOT CONCLUDED ON PURPOSE: everything WITH DAC read Price pending because this env seeds prices for only 18 products, so I draw NO conclusion about WITH DAC 2mg/5mg direct routing, and none about Hexarelin/Oxytocin pricing which is still with the founder - each appears exactly once in the artifact so no duplicate pair was seen.
